definition: All catalogue records satisfying the published inclusion rule for each Release 1 source, plus the curated priority collection.
statement: Bounded-exhaustive for four declared global machine-readable catalogues at the cut-off date. The India extension is a verified official subset across all registered source families, not yet source-complete.
indiaStatus: 600 India-specific indicator records; 76 are discoverable under the Immunization programme filter.
ntepPublicBoundaryStatus: Deep source-bounded extraction complete for declared public KPI, laboratory, DR-TB and Panchayat sources; restricted Ni-kshay data dictionary pending.
hmisStatus: Public-source-bounded research structure; not a complete live national HMIS dictionary.
rmnchaStatus: Bounded-exhaustive for the RMNCH+A Strategy scorecard (42), LaQshya Annexure C (20), and RKSK framework indicator tables (99); current restricted portal dictionaries and newer child-health manuals remain in the evidence-gap register.
immunizationStatus: Bounded-exhaustive for the declared IMI 2017 monitoring lists (21), IMI 2.0 dashboard and DQA tables (24), AEFI 2024 monitoring list (8), and medical-officer handbook coverage/dropout measures (6); authenticated live portal dictionaries remain explicit evidence gaps.
